newsitem.title: UK: Persona buys remaining stake in Spanish unit.
newsitem.headline: Persona buys remaining stake in Spanish unit.

text.p: British computer network and communications product distributor Persona Group Plc said on Wednesday it had become the sole owner of its Spanish subsidiary after acquiring the remaining 20 percent.

In its statement Persona did not disclose the purchase price of the minority stake in Top Log Iberica, its Madrid-based computer network and communications distribution subsidiary and a company spokeswoman confirmed they would not release it.
However, she said that Top Log Iberica had sales around four million stg a year and was "slightly profitable."

"The acquisition of this minority interest confirms our commitment to expansion throughout Europe," Persona Group's Chairman Wayne Channon said. "It is a good base from which to increase our presence in the Spanish market."
At 0852 GMT Persona shares were unchanged at 301.5 pence.
